newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MIXED IN QUIET TRADE.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE DOLLAR ENDS MIXED IN QUIET TRADE.

text.p: The Zimbabwe dollar was quoted mixed against major currencies at the close of Monday's lacklustre interbank session, dealers said.
"It was a very quiet market; no interbank deals were done today and the dollar closed where it was in the morning," commented a dealer.

The local unit finished the day at last Friday's 10.6000/6200 against the U.S. dollar but weakened against pound sterling to 17.0900/1500, in response to the U.S. dollar's losses against the pound overseas.
It also was also marginally softer at 6.9600/9800 against the German mark compared to 6.9580/9750 but edged up on the troubled rand to 2.2800/2900 from 2.2970/3040.
